summary: Methanex Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its Annual General Meeting held April 30, 2026. All director nominees were elected with strong support (99.10%-99.95% for), KPMG was re-appointed as auditor (76.52% for), and the advisory vote on executive compensation was approved (97.86% for). With 83.27% of shares represented, this is a routine post-meeting disclosure of ordinary governance matters, not a special situation. No acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or other event-driven categories apply.
